description.en: A unified activity for supported Arabic manga and manhwa reading websites, with chapter details, covers, site branding, reading-session timing, and sensitive-content filtering.
description.ar: حضور موحد لمواقع قراءة المانجا والمانهوا العربية المدعومة، يعرض العمل والفصل والغلاف وشعار الموقع ومدة جلسة القراءة مع تصفية الاعمال ذات المحتوى الحساس.

settings.title: Show manga cover
settings.description: Use the current manga/manhwa cover as the large Discord image when available.

settings.title: Show site logo
settings.description: Show the current website icon next to the manga cover when available.

settings.title: Show reading time
settings.description: Show how long you have been reading the current title or browsing the site.

settings.title: Show open button
settings.description: Add a Discord button that opens the current chapter or title page.
